verdict.rationale: Extensive first-party AMD Ryzen AI documentation confirms support across ONNX Runtime (Vitis AI EP, DirectML EP), llama.cpp (GPU-only path), OGA (NPU-only/hybrid), and the Lemonade SDK, plus community hands-on reports of running llama.cpp models on Strix Halo with real token/sec figures. missing for 10: independent MLX support evidence (MLX is Apple-only so not applicable, but no third-party benchmark validation of AMD's own runtime claims beyond community anecdotes).
